title: Community image models can support reference-image edits
summary:
Community image editing and Nemotron arrived alongside sturdier image fallbacks and clearer API errors.

Community image model registration now checks whether a model can edit source images. Models that pass advertise image input and `/v1/images/edits`; generation-only models keep their existing text-to-image behavior.

Added NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra as `nemotron`, with text, tool calling, reasoning, and a 262,144-token context window. Separate model maintenance moved Mercury 2 through OpenRouter and corrected the provider label for Nova Canvas and Nova Reel without changing their model IDs.

FLUX.1 Schnell now falls back to Replicate when its primary GPU pool has no worker or a request fails, replacing a fallback that returned 404. Z-Image worker startup was also tightened so workers pass a local health check before accepting shared traffic.

highlights.title: Edit with community models
highlights.text: Community image models that support editing can now take a reference image through `/v1/images/edits`. Generation-only models continue to work as before. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
highlights.text: Use `nemotron` for text, tool calling, and reasoning with a 262,144-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nemotron).
